title: VAT Calculator
description: Add or remove VAT at any rate you set.
howto: Choose: add VAT to a net price, remove VAT from a gross price, or show the VAT portion inside a gross price.
Read the net, VAT, and gross amounts.

faqs.q: How do I extract VAT from a gross price?
faqs.a: Choose 'Remove VAT': net = gross / (1 + rate), and VAT = gross - net.
VAT/GST rates differ by country and product. Enter the rate that applies to your case.

faqs.q: Is VAT the same as sales tax?
faqs.a: Not exactly. VAT is charged at each stage of production with credits; sales tax is charged once at the final sale. The math here works for either.
